Post-incident review: checkout latency, October 14

Between 09:12 and 09:58 Eastern, checkout requests took a median of 6.4 seconds, against a normal 0.8 seconds. About 3 percent of customers abandoned their carts during that window.

The cause was an eviction storm after a config change reduced the cache size from 8 GB to 2 GB. Vasquez reverted the change at 09:51, and latency returned to normal within seven minutes.

The follow-up actions are a review gate for cache config changes and an alert on eviction rate, both owned by Abernathy and due November 6.
